new_value: Fixed in 1a8e749: --list-secret-keys replaces --list-keys (parser retargeted pub/sub -> sec/ssb), the fpr following sec names the identity instead of the last subkey's, and the SPIFFE path carries the full fingerprint (did:key the full SHA-256). Fixtures are real gpg output from throwaway keys. Verified on the real keyring: strangers' keys gone, 15 candidates, all full 40-hex.
